Name: Specialty Cafe Drinks
Author: ahri1014
Description:
[font=Calibri]Adds 16 new drink recipes, which you can purchase from Gus after learning how to make the tea sapling (he’ll send you a letter!).

As an espresso and tea addict, I decided we really needed more drink variety! I wanted to keep it vanilla-friendly and also make drinks I think would taste good in real life. Also, who doesn’t want longer Espresso speed buffs?

Below are all of the drinks and their recipes, but you’ll have to see the buffs in-game! Hope you enjoy <3

[size=5][center][color=#664e38]Espresso[/color] Drinks:[/center][/size]
[size=4][color=#664e38] ﻿Winter Star Latte[/color][/size] - A warm drink that makes you want to cozy up by the fire.
Triple Shot Espresso + Ginger + Milk
[size=4][color=#664e38] ﻿Affogato[/color][/size] - A sweet treat for coffee lovers!
Triple Shot Espresso + Ice Cream
[size=4][color=#664e38] ﻿Coconut Milk Latte[/color][/size] - A rich and creamy latte with coconut notes throughout.
Triple Shot Espresso + Coconutx2
[size=4][color=#664e38] ﻿Pumpkin Spice Latte[/color][/size] - An autumn classic full of pumpkin and spices!
Triple Shot Espresso + Pumpkin + Milk

[size=5][center][color=tan]Coffee[/color] Drinks:[/center][/size]

[size=4][color=tan] ﻿Cookie Butter Mocha[/color][/size] - Creamy cookie butter makes this mocha extra rich.
Coffee + Cookies + Milk
[size=4][color=tan] ﻿Maple Sugar Macchiato[/color][/size] - A perfect blend of maple sugar, cream, and coffee.
Coffee + Maple Syrup + Sugar
[size=4][color=tan] ﻿Hazelnut Mocha[/color][/size] - This drink reminds you of foiled hazelnut chocolates.
Coffee + Hazelnut + Milk
[size=4][color=tan] ﻿Vanilla Frappe[/color][/size] - A classic sweet treat perfect for sunny days.
Coffee + Milk + Sugar
[center]
[size=5][color=lightgreen]Green Tea[/color] Drinks:[/size][/center]

[size=4][color=lightgreen] ﻿Matcha Latte[/color][/size] - An energizing matcha latte to get you through the day!
Green Tea + Triple Shot Espresso + Milk
[size=4][color=lightgreen] ﻿Berry Blend Tea[/color][/size] - This tea is berry sweet.
Green Tea + Strawberry + Blueberryx2
[size=4][color=lightgreen] ﻿Lush Spring Tea[/color][/size] - A tea that fully embodies spring flavors.
Green Tea + Dandelion + Tulip
[size=4][color=lightgreen] ﻿Sweet Bee’s Peach Tea[/color][/size] - A very refreshing iced sweet peach tea.
Green Tea + Peach + Honey

[size=5][center][color=lightpink]Floral Tea[/color] Drinks:[/center][/size]

[size=4][color=lightpink] ﻿Rosy Breeze Tea[/color][/size] - A fragrant rose tea with notes of orange and ginger.
Fairy Rose + Orange + Ginger
[size=4][color=lightpink] ﻿Sunny Tropics Tea[/color][/size] - A mild sunflower tea with notes of mango and pineapple.
Sunflower + Mango + Pineapple
[size=4][color=lightpink] ﻿Misty Nights Tea[/color][/size] - A mild, sweet crocus tea with notes of crystal fruit and blackberries.
Crocus + Crystal Fruit + Blackberry
[size=4][color=lightpink] ﻿Plum Passion Tea[/color][/size] - A fragrant rose tea with notes of apple, plum, and cinnamon.
Fairy Rose + Apple + Wild Plum
